annotation_id.description: Reviewed annotation identifier, not an inferred note.
annotation_id.title: Annotation Id

anyOf.description: Expression in docs/expr-dsl.md; never a JSON number.

applies_when.description: Selected annotation predicate, re-evaluated after runtime parameter changes.
applies_when.title: Applies When

context.description: Fixed extraction facts for applies_when; runtime params remain in the IR environment.
context.title: Context

level.description: KERNEL preserves semantics; LAYOUT changes storage; SEMANTIC changes graph/communication.
level.title: Level

note.description: Reviewed explanation; KERNEL badges hidden by default.
note.title: Note

src.description: Script-resolved replacement/patch declarations, can include multiple relevant sources.

tag.description: Sorted overlay badges; independent of significance level.
tag.title: Tag

bus_bytes.description: Local-rank estimated link traffic, includes collective algorithm factor; zero when inactive.

group.description: Parallel group name (tp/ep/pp/dp) or a rule-declared group.
group.title: Group

logical_bytes.description: Local-rank logical tensor bytes explicitly for each phase.

notes.description: Ring/dispatch/routing assumptions, especially EP uniform routing.
notes.title: Notes

op.description: Logical collective; fused kernels retain semantic communication metadata.
op.title: Op

when.description: Activation condition; inactive communication contributes zero.
when.title: When

ascend.description: Reviewed overlay; absence means no claim of Ascend differences.

bytes_moved.description: Local-rank estimated HBM bytes read/written per phase, excluding communication bus bytes.

class.description: Qualified baseline class or semantic operation symbol.
class.title: Class

comm.description: Collective metadata or null; traffic is separate from HBM bytes.

flops.description: Local-rank floating-point work; one multiply-add is two FLOPs.

id.description: Stable semantic node key; does not encode layout coordinates or mutable labels.
id.title: Id

in.description: Named input tensor slots, each with symbolic local shape.
in.title: In

kind.description: Semantic node category; group metrics summarize descendants.
kind.title: Kind

label.description: Human-readable node label, independent of identity.
label.title: Label

out.description: Named output tensor slots, each with symbolic local shape.
out.title: Out

parallel.description: Extensible ParallelSpec axes, including tp/pp/dp/ep/sp/dcp/pcp where supported.
parallel.title: Parallel

parent.description: Containing group node id; null for top-level nodes. Acyclic hierarchy.
parent.title: Parent

rule.description: Matched Rule.id; coverage gate fails if no rule matches.
rule.title: Rule

src.description: Baseline class/function declaration resolved by script.

weight_bytes.description: Resident weight bytes on this rank; group totals include descendants, never sum groups and children together.
weight_bytes.title: Weight Bytes

id.description: Stable layer-band key, used by L1:<band>.
id.title: Id

layers.description: Inclusive start/end layer indices as expression strings.

template.description: Decoder/group IR node id instantiated for this layer band.

activation_peak.description: Peak live HBM bytes during max_num_batched_tokens profiling; include sampler/logits peak.

kv_per_token.description: Local-rank KV bytes for one cached token across resident layers, including KV head replication.

unmodelled.description: Named exclusions/uncertainties (graph capture, allocator fragmentation, HCCL workspace); prose, not numeric expressions.
